summary: A Yes vote authorizes the Alview-Dairyland Union School District to issue general obligation bonds repaid by district property taxes.

schools.text: A Yes vote would authorize a bond for the Alview-Dairyland Union School District.
schools.quote: Measure V-Alview-Dairyland Union School District Bond

schools.text: A No vote would reject the bond for the Alview-Dairyland Union School District.
